name: Boring Apartments
justification: Pure counting with a tiny closed form; unambiguous single-number output, but no real aha moment.
solution_sketch: For x made of digit d repeated L times, all shorter groups 1..d-1 cost 1+2+3+4=10 each, and the current group costs 1+..+L. Answer = 10*(d-1) + L*(L+1)/2.
